summary: IT Manager with 26+ years of experience in infrastructure management, project leadership, and client relations across corporate and remote environments.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems

experience.title: IT Manager
responsibilities: Stabilized and managed infrastructure and applications for corporate and remote facilities.
Created standard hardware and software lists and managed procurement.
Prepared fiscal year IT budget and performed IT audits with recommendations.
Administered IT systems, managed projects, and defined employee training programs.
Maintained production database applications and analyzed system performance for upgrades.
Reduced downtime by diagnosing and resolving complex issues.
Negotiated vendor contracts and streamlined internal communication platforms.
Conducted vulnerability assessments, security audits, and implemented VoIP phone system.
Managed corporate website and collaborated with departments on technology needs.
Provided end‑user support for in‑office and remote users.

experience.title: Senior Technical Analyst
responsibilities: Led a help desk team serving over 30 clients, ensuring high customer satisfaction.
Monitored ticket queues, escalated issues, and maintained communication with clients.
Administered IT systems, analyzed performance, and recommended infrastructure upgrades.
Developed technical documentation, help desk policies, and budget plans.
Acted as account owner for select accounts and coordinated technical training.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Managed corporate network, ensured high availability, and developed backup/disaster recovery plans.
Administered MPLS network, coordinated remote office construction, and implemented monitoring.
Managed corporate phone and voicemail systems and provided support to all personnel.
Communicated technical matters to the President/CEO.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Oversaw corporate network, disaster recovery, and backup procedures for 68 LANs.
Implemented document management and incident reporting systems.
Managed IT staff, created policies, and prepared annual IT budget.
Negotiated vendor contracts, provided end‑user training, and reduced costs on cell phones and travel.

experience.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Led installation team for radiology department, gathering requirements and ensuring quality.
Coordinated with sales, vendors, and hospital staff to meet project timelines.
Ensured HIPAA compliance, investigated DICOM compatibility, and deployed standard PC images.
Developed help desk procedures and communicated project needs to management.
